decision: MEASUREMENT_INVALID_CLAIM_UNCHANGED_AT_HYPOTHESIS_NO_PROMOTION_NO_RETIREMENT: the frozen decision rule's first gate (prereg.md 7.1 step 1, V1-V11) failed on V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE, and the independent audit concurs (audit.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false, claim_ceiling 'cannot support C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE at any claim status above HYPOTHESIS'). I verified the cause directly in the control plane: scripts/freeze_experiment.py writes exactly three sha256 keys (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md) and can never hash code, and check_scope.py stage_policy restricts DESIGN to {exp}/spec.json, {exp}/prereg.md, {exp}/failure.json, {exp}/model_design.json, so outcome-bearing code cannot exist at freeze time in ANY lane. V9 as frozen is therefore unsatisfiable by construction and this is a control-plane defect, not an execution failure by the producer and not a scientific falsification. The pre-declared falsifier in spec.json.falsifier and prereg.md section 2 was NOT validly triggered, so the claim stays at its registry ceiling of HYPOTHESIS. What the packet does establish, below the claim ceiling and verified by me directly from raw_evidence/task_results.jsonl, is a bounded decomposition: the goal-to-mechanism selection signal (unseen paraphrase 19/20 for the embedding route against 15/20 for the lexical null; 45/52 for the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference; 52/52 for the internal-id oracle, so the ceiling is reachable) is separable from, and was destroyed by, an abstention policy that no calibrated gate ever made: the fitted gate fired on 0 of 52 applicable goals at its own selected threshold and all 28 candidate abstentions came from a non-calibrated slot filler. continue=false because the next step needs a new Global Research Director mandate (all repairs are design- or control-plane-level) plus a control-plane decision on the freezer, not an immediate lane re-chain.

claim_updates.reason: No change from the pre-experiment registry ceiling (research/claims/registry.json: C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE status HYPOTHESIS, owner_lanes graph/product/frontier, next_gate 'unseen-goal resolution with applicability/abstention calibration'; codex/claim_state.json latest_event_by_claim.C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is also HYPOTHESIS). The producer did NOT claim a falsification: result.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE, and controls['A-CANDIDATE'].verdict='FALSIFIED_ON_ITS_OWN_TERMS' is annotated in the packet itself as 'NOT the packet's status'. The independent audit returns status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID with producer_claim_supported=false. Under the frozen rule (spec.json.decision_rule.outcomes.MEASUREMENT_INVALID; prereg.md 7.1 gate order 'V1-V11 -> degeneracy screen -> positive control -> oracle ceiling -> null control -> calibration fitted -> primary -> secondary') gate 1 fails on V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE and short-circuits, so neither the primary gate nor the four failing secondary gates is a validly reached verdict about the claim. I confirmed the cause is structural rather than behavioural: freeze.json contains hashes for prereg.md, request.json and spec.json only, scripts/freeze_experiment.py (read by me) has no code-hashing branch at all, and DESIGN cannot create code, so no compliant execution of this design was possible in any lane at any time. Because VALIDATED requires a PASS audit and REJECTED would assert a global falsification the audit explicitly declines to make, HYPOTHESIS is the only admissible ceiling. Three bounded facts are recorded at the observational level and are explicitly NOT claim status: (1) SELECTION SIGNAL IS REAL AND SEPARABLE - on the 52 applicable goals A-CANDIDATE 36/52, B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP 36/52 (difference exactly 0.0, one-sided lower 95% -0.0652, p=0.5943), A-REFERENCE-EMBEDARGMAX 45/52, B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE 52/52, B-RANDOM-ROLE 7/52, A-INCUMBENT 0/52; per category paraphrase 19/20 vs 15/20 vs 19/20, underspecified 0/10 vs 5/10 vs 9/10, composite 5/10 vs 4/10 vs 5/10, verbatim 12/12 for all three, with contingency 29 both-correct / 7 candidate-only / 7 lexical-only / 9 neither, and the candidate's correct set a strict subset of the argmax reference's (36 shared, 0 candidate-only, 9 argmax-only). I recomputed every one of these counts from the 480 raw rows. The pooled tie is a compositional cancellation of +4, -5 and +1, not evidence of equivalence, and the paraphrase category - the actual unseen-goal generalisation test named by the registry next_gate - favours the semantic route. (2) THE FITTED GATE WAS INERT - p_applicable spans [0.6785, 0.9468] over the applicable goals, the selected threshold is 0.02, 0 of 52 fall below it, and all 28 candidate abstentions carry abstain_reason='unfilled_parameter_slots'; w=2.6927, b=0.1853 with w_spread 1.1230 across independent refits satisfy V4's letter (fitted, not algebraic) while the device that actually abstained is uncalibrated, so ece_global 0.2030, ece_per_class_max 0.7885 and unknown_precision 0.6071 score rows the gate never decided. (3) A SAFETY BLIND SPOT IN THE FROZEN METRIC SUITE - on the 20 goals with no applicable mechanism the candidate produced 11 EXECUTABLE decisions at mean p 0.7787, invisible to the primary metric, to false-accept under reading R1 and to both ECE gates. Bounded negative that the audit itself states and I adopt: a fitted logistic gate over embedding cosine with a generic keyword slot filler, on this 20-mechanism bound-slot fixture, does not exceed a lexical-overlap null and loses to the same embedding signal without a gate. That bounds this resolver configuration at this ceiling. It does not bound semantic resolution, does not close the claim, and does not license the retirement that spec.json.product_consequence_negative contemplates.

No change from the pre-experiment registry ceiling (research/claims/registry.json: C-PARAM-INHERIT status EXPERIMENTAL, owner_lanes graph/product, next_gate 'learn on resource A, succeed on never-observed B against cold/replay/retrieval baselines'). This event records a dependency fact for Product, not a claim update. A-INCUMBENT produced 0 of 80 EXECUTABLE decisions and 80 UNKNOWN in this packet (result.json.controls.A-INCUMBENT, OBS-12, derived_evidence/degeneracy_screen.json .incumbent), and the cause is a DIFFERENT one from the parent packet's, which makes the finding stronger rather than repetitive. I read src/spider/kernel.py at the execution base commit 7f5879fc directly: resolve() at lines 93-123 requires m.intent == intent as exact string equality (line 97) AND every slot in set(m.parameter_slots) | _template_slots(m.action_template) to be present in the supplied params dict (lines 104-106), else the mechanism is skipped and cannot become a candidate. This packet's V11 fixture deliberately gives every mechanism a NON-EMPTY parameter_slots, and the incumbent adapter supplies params={}, so zero mechanisms can ever become a candidate - the leg is empty by code certainty, not by measurement, and the leg would be empty on ANY fixture that requires bound parameter slots. prereg.md 4.2's expectation that the incumbent's mechanisms carry parameter_slots=[] therefore contradicts V11 inside the same frozen document, which is a design-consistency defect the next design must not repeat. Independently confirmed again here and in the parent packet: distill() at lines 74-91 emits confidence=0.5 with no parameter_slots, the default min_confidence is 0.8 (line 59) and line 114 returns EXPLORE below it, so EXECUTABLE is unreachable at the default configuration; and a repository grep for 'def distill_parameterized' and 'def align_parameters' under src/ returns zero matches on a 132-line kernel. Consequence for the next design: the committed kernel cannot serve as a non-empty comparison leg on this class of fixture, so a substitute reference arm must be declared in advance rather than discovered empty at run time. Scope is deliberately narrow - the kernel at this commit and this fixture class. This event must not be read as a new rejection, a narrowing, a retirement, or a license to treat the claim's existing bounded ceiling as reduced, and no Parameterized-induction capability is implied to exist.

product_action: NO_PROMOTION and NO_RETIREMENT. Nothing from this packet may enter Product Core, and nothing from it licenses retiring semantic resolution as an architectural component. promote_to_product is false and could not be otherwise: this is the graph lane, product's allowed_code_roots are src/tests/sdk, and the only promotable-looking artifact is research-harness code under this experiment directory (artifacts/candidate_resolver.py sha256 ef33487c..., artifacts/experiment_runner.py sha256 70db9395...) which is not product code, was never bound to the freeze by any pre-execution digest, and is a research resolver with no product surface. The specific product-relevant readings are all negative or unknown and must not be inverted: the resolver's headline number mechanism_identity_accuracy 0.6923 is not economics, latency, model calls, retrieval cost or amortization and is not comparable to any of those; the false_accept_rate column is not comparable across arms at all because the candidate's cell uses an all-80 numerator over a 52-goal denominator while every other arm uses an all-80 numerator over all 80 (OBS-11), so no false-accept economics may be quoted; the ECE and UNKNOWN-precision failures are attributable to a device that made zero decisions; and the one genuinely product-relevant safety observation is that the candidate confidently executed against a mechanism that does not exist on 11 of 20 such goals at mean p 0.7787, which is an argument against shipping this class of resolver, not for it. spec.json.product_consequence_positive (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances to EXPERIMENTAL, unblocking C-LLM-INHERIT, C-CROSSSITE and C-PRODUCT-ECON) is NOT triggered, because gate 1 of the frozen gate order failed before the primary gate was reached. Equally, no new block is authorized in the other direction: the report's and spec's framing of downstream consequences must not be read as changing C-LLM-INHERIT, C-CROSSSITE or C-PRODUCT-ECON, whose codex latest states stand unchanged (C-LLM-INHERIT MEASUREMENT_INVALID, C-CROSSSITE HYPOTHESIS, C-PRODUCT-ECON HYPOTHESIS). The one product-durable fact this packet re-confirms is the negative capability fact that the committed kernel at this commit returns UNKNOWN or EXPLORE rather than EXECUTABLE on a bound-slot fixture, so any product architecture that assumes inherited mechanisms actually execute must be costed against a kernel that abstains; that is a cost input, not a promotion, and it is already recorded by the parent packet and the mandate's portfolio assessment.
next_question: Given that goal-to-mechanism selection is now demonstrably separable from abstention policy (on the 52 applicable goals of EXP-GRAPH-36279237023 the fitted-gate candidate and the lexical-overlap null both bind 36, the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference binds 45 and the internal-id oracle binds 52 so the ceiling is reachable, and the candidate beats lexical 19/20 to 15/20 on unseen paraphrased goals while scoring 0/10 on goals that omit a required parameter), and given that the calibrated applicability gate in that packet was formally fitted yet fired on 0 of 52 applicable goals at its own selected threshold, so that every abstention in it was produced by a non-calibrated slot filler and the confident wrong executions on goals with no applicable mechanism were invisible to every frozen gate: on a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application with a frozen registry of bound parameter slots and a frozen goal set whose applicable and no-applicable counts are machine-derived from the goal file rather than declared in prose, (i) does an applicability gate fitted against a labelled POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE class - applicable goals versus goals for which no registered mechanism applies - become non-inert and can it hold the safety and calibration gates at acceptable coverage; (ii) with abstention scored as its own outcome class rather than silently as an error, does the selection accuracy of the embedding route hold at or above the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference on the goals the arm chooses to answer, once paired with a coverage/selective-risk pair and with the parameter-omitting goals analysed as a declared deferral class rather than as guaranteed errors; (iii) with exactly one preregistered pooled false-accept definition whose numerator counts wrong EXECUTABLE decisions on ALL goals including those with no applicable mechanism, does confident wrong execution on no-applicable goals fall at or below a preregistered bound that the current suite could not see; and (iv) with a preregistered headroom screen for the lexical-overlap null computed on APPLICABLE goals only, a substitute reference arm declared in advance as non-empty by construction (the incumbent kernel cannot serve, because src/spider/kernel.py:resolve() requires exact intent equality and every parameter slot to be present in the supplied params, so it returns UNKNOWN on any fixture that requires bound slots), and explicit train/validation/test splits so the primary metric is not reported on the union of the fitting data. The packet must additionally bind its outcome-bearing code to the freeze in a way the deterministic control plane can actually satisfy: sha256 values of the resolver, goal generator, metric estimators and fixture declared inside prereg.md, which freeze.json does hash, against modules that already exist at freeze time under the lane's allowed code roots, with EXECUTE recomputing those digests and failing measurement validity on mismatch - and must NOT freeze any validity condition of the form 'code hashed into freeze.json', which scripts/freeze_experiment.py can never satisfy, so that the failure mode that just invalidated two consecutive Graph packets cannot recur; and must preregister an instrument-dynamic-range precondition, executed and logged before any candidate arm runs, requiring the fitted gate to fire on at least a declared non-zero fraction of both the applicable and the no-applicable classes, otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
reason: Adjudicated against the frozen packet and the independent audit, not against the producer's narrative. result.json reports status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and outcome=INCONCLUSIVE - the producer did not claim a falsification, and it explicitly declined to let its own control-level label 'FALSIFIED_ON_ITS_OWN_TERMS' become the packet status, which is the honest behaviour. audit.json reports status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false, and a claim_ceiling that the design 'cannot support C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE at any claim status above HYPOTHESIS'. The frozen rule then agrees on its own terms: prereg.md 7.1 evaluates V1-V11 first and short-circuits, and V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE fails. I verified the cause myself rather than accepting it: freeze.json carries exactly three hashes and no code; scripts/freeze_experiment.py builds its freeze payload from request.json, spec.json and prereg.md only, with no code-hashing branch; and check_scope.py's DESIGN policy allows writing only {exp}/spec.json, {exp}/prereg.md, {exp}/failure.json and {exp}/model_design.json, so outcome-bearing code cannot exist at freeze time in any lane. The producer recorded the same cause, refused to repair it because repair would have required editing an immutable frozen file or an out-of-scope script, and reported every gate in full so nothing measured would be discarded. That is correct, and it is why this packet is informative rather than empty. What the measurements show, and I confirmed all of it by recomputing from the 480 raw rows in raw_evidence/task_results.jsonl: the primary comparison is an exact tie with the lexical null at 36/52 (difference 0.0, one-sided lower 95% -0.0652, p 0.5943) that decomposes into +4 on unseen paraphrase, -5 on goals that omit a required parameter and +1 on composite goals, with contingency 29/7/7/9; the uncalibrated embedding-argmax reference, which does strictly less, reaches 45/52 and contains the candidate's correct set as a strict subset; the oracle reaches 52/52 so the ceiling is reachable and 0.6923 is a real gap rather than an unsolvable fixture; the fitted gate (w 2.6927, b 0.1853, w_spread 1.1230 across refits) passes V4's letter while firing on 0 of 52 applicable goals at its own selected threshold 0.02, so all 28 abstentions came from a non-calibrated slot filler and the ECE and UNKNOWN-precision gates score rows the gate never decided; and the candidate executed on 11 of 20 no-applicable goals at mean p 0.7787 in a region no frozen gate could see. Three further defects bound how far any of this can be read: the pooled false-accept denominator is ambiguous in the frozen text and the coded value is a hybrid - reading R4 for the candidate and R2 for every other arm - making that the only gate whose verdict is interpretation-dependent (R1 gives the candidate 0.0962 and a PASS while failing the lexical null at 0.3077; R2, R3 and R4 all fail); the V8(a) headroom screen is structurally non-binding because the lexical null never abstains, so its all-80 accuracy is capped at 52/80 = 0.65 for any lexical selector while its applicable-only accuracy is 0.6923 including 15/20 paraphrase; and the frozen prereg's own '60 applicable' arithmetic contradicts its own goal table and its own null control, so the 52-goal denominator is used throughout and the discrepancy is carried rather than silently normalized. The design also contradicts itself on the incumbent: prereg.md 4.2 expects incumbent mechanisms with empty parameter_slots while V11 forbids them, which is why that leg is empty by code certainty on a fixture of exactly the opposite shape from the parent's. Two consecutive Graph packets have now been lost to design- or control-plane defects rather than to substrate - the parent's to construct validity, controls and gate adjudication, this one to a freezer that cannot hash code - and that pattern, not any resolver, is what the Global Research Director needs to see. The correct next step is therefore a new mandated experiment whose instrument has dynamic range, plus a control-plane decision about the freezer; neither is a lane-chained continuation, hence continue=false with next_question carried for the pulse. No file in this packet is edited by this verdict, and no lane-state, Codex or constitutional file is touched.
